1. Engagement Scope

This report outlines findings from a compliance review of National Center for Organizational Health's leave of absence administration processes. The scope covered FMLA, ADA, and state-specific leave laws in 16 states, and included a review of 64 leave cases from the period 1992-11-03 to 1992-12-28.

2. Methodology

The compliance framework used for this assessment is a composite of federal law, state regulations in 16 key jurisdictions, and leading industry practices as documented in ACPWB's proprietary compliance database. Each finding is mapped to the specific requirement it contravenes.

4. Detailed Findings
NDR-4292-001INFORMATIONALIN PROGRESS
Observation

Genetic information (GINA) requested on post-offer medical questionnaire for 64 new hires

Corrective Action Required

The compliance department will develop and implement a risk-based monitoring and testing program for key HR compliance areas, with results reported to the Audit Committee on a quarterly basis.

Management Response

National Center for Organizational Health accepts this finding. A corrective action plan has been developed and assigned to the designated owner. Implementation is targeted for completion by the due date indicated. Progress will be reported to ACPWB on a monthly basis until formal closure.

Owner: Senior Director of Communications • Due: 1993-01-28
NDR-6012-002INFORMATIONALIN PROGRESS
Observation

Job classification accuracy below 92% benchmark for exempt/non-exempt designations

Corrective Action Required

Implement a "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" link on all internal and external career pages and establish a process for responding to employee data requests under CCPA/CPRA.

Management Response

The condition identified has been partially remediated. National Center for Organizational Health has addressed the majority of the affected population and is on track for full closure by the due date. A status update will be provided at the next scheduled review.

Owner: Senior Manager of Advocacy • Due: 1993-02-28
NDR-6203-003INFORMATIONALOPEN
Observation

Stock option grant approval dates do not align with board meeting minutes for 64 awards

Corrective Action Required

Implement a mandatory annual training program for all supervisors on the proper classification of employees under the FLSA, with a focus on the duties tests for executive, administrative, and professional exemptions.

Management Response

The finding is accepted. We have implemented a manual control as an interim solution while a permanent system fix is being developed. The manual control is performed daily by the compliance team.

Owner: Director of Compensation & Benefits • Due: 1993-02-28
NDR-8987-004LOWMONITORING
Observation

Genetic information (GINA) requested on post-offer medical questionnaire for 64 new hires

Corrective Action Required

A third-party specialist will be engaged annually to provide §280G "golden parachute" calculations for all named executive officers in connection with any potential change-in-control scenario.

Management Response

The finding is valid. The required report has been developed and is now generated and distributed automatically on a weekly basis. See attached sample report as evidence.

Owner: Manager of Compensation Programs • Due: 1993-01-28
NDR-5870-005LOWDEFERRED
Observation

E-Verify case for 64 new hires not initiated within the three-day post-hire requirement

Corrective Action Required

Implement a "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" link on all internal and external career pages and establish a process for responding to employee data requests under CCPA/CPRA.

Management Response

This issue has been escalated to the executive steering committee for prioritization and resource allocation. A formal response will be provided following the committee's next scheduled meeting on 1992-11-03.

Owner: Director of Human Resources • Due: 1993-03-28
NDR-4520-006LOWOPEN
Observation

Employee acknowledgment records incomplete for revised compensation policy (v1.0-FINAL)

Corrective Action Required

Perform a root cause analysis of the EEO-1 Component 2 data errors and implement validation controls in the data preparation process to prevent recurrence in future reporting cycles.

Management Response

While we accept the factual basis of the finding, we have performed a risk assessment and formally accepted the residual risk. This decision has been documented and approved by the Chief Risk Officer. No further corrective action is planned at this time.

Owner: Director of Revenue Operations • Due: 1993-01-28
